raw: [name="Hoshiguma"]  No matter how you look at it, Reunion is weaker than we expected. Despite that, they still managed to take Chernobog.

raw: [name="Hoshiguma"]  Also, you have a weak point. I can't stress this enough, but never let your thoughts consume you. Ever.

content: Also, you have a weak point. I can't stress this enough, but never let your thoughts consume you. Ever.

raw: [name="Hoshiguma"]  Don't be so obsessed with something that you neglect the other possibilities. There is nothing out there worth going off to battle for, except for your continued existence.

content: Don't be so obsessed with something that you neglect the other possibilities. There is nothing out there worth going off to battle for, except for your continued existence.

speaker: Swire

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  All of you assembled here are the cream of the crop. As we speak, many of our colleagues are still out there fighting. But we have our own mission.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  But now, it has fallen into Reunion's hands, and has been tainted by conspiracy and warfare.

raw: [name="Ch'en"]  No matter how you feel, we are the L.G.D. We aren't rioters, nor are we criminals.
